reader.requirement: At --std 85 READ ... INTO is the READ followed, only when it succeeds, by a MOVE of the current record to identifier-1 under the MOVE rules (alphanumeric to numeric, editing, truncation, JUSTIFIED, reference-modified receivers, a group record as a group move), its size from the RECORD clause (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12), a group move for RECORD IS VARYING, subscripts of identifier-1 evaluated after the read; the record stays in the record area too.

edition-consulted.switches: PhraseAt(DialectLevel) picks the MOVE-rule citation and the GR7 (1985) versus SR1 (2023) admissibility wording; diagnostics only
nothing in the move construction: BoundCurrentRecord and its group-move flag are edition-free

reader.edition-search: BindIntoPhrase and IntoPhraseRules read; grep DialectLevel|Edition in MoveBinder.cs and SequentialIoEmitter.cs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf25_07 covers JUSTIFIED, VARYING DEPENDING group move, subscript after read, no move at end; not exercised: alphanumeric to numeric, a group record into numeric-edited, reference-modified and shorter receivers, VARYING without DEPENDING (GR12 b), no move on a 47

INTO sends the DEPENDING length 3 and the truncated 10 (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12 a)

reader.notes: The INTO move is bound once as a MOVE from BoundCurrentRecord (VARYING) or the record area (fixed), and emitted inside the success branch, with identifier-1 resolved at store time. At 2023 p5gr8b stops at compile because MOVE ALL '*' TO a numeric-edited item was removed (COBOL0902), a probe-setup line, not this rule.
reader.at-2023: the probe does not compile at 2023 (COBOL0902 on the setup MOVE ALL); the witness's legs are edition-free code

refuter.evidence: r5gr8.cob (refute-1985-124/r5gr8-001, --std 85), GR7 a forms the reader did not try: a lone elementary numeric record 9(3)V99 holding 123.45 READ INTO 9(5)V9(3) gives the numeric move (value 00123.450), INTO -ZZ9.99 gives [ 123.45] (numeric to numeric-edited, not a group move), a SIGN LEADING SEPARATE S9(3) record -42 INTO S9(5) SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE gives [00042-]; a RECORD IS VARYING 2 TO 6 file without DEPENDING ON whose record has OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON O-N, written with O-N 2 (3 characters), READ INTO X(8) prefilled with * gives [2AB     ]: a group move of the 3 characters read (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12 b), padded with spaces. r3gr5-002: READ F INTO T(F-N) evaluates the subscript from the record just read. (DISPLAY of a 9(5)V9(3) item prints its point, [00123.450], also from WORKING-STORAGE in r5disp-001: a DISPLAY matter, not this rule.) The only INTO divergence seen, in r2gr13-001 (DEPENDING item 15 but 10 characters sent), follows from the GR13 defect recorded on 1985-GR-VII.4.4.4-13, not from the INTO move. cite.py: OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR8 (4.4.4 General Rules) the text is in GR8; OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12 (3.8.4 General Rules) the text is in GR12.
